blocks.prompt: 1 (i) Express the following products as sums or differences: \(2\sin 3\theta \cos \theta\)
blocks.explanation:
Bachon, yahan sine aur cosine ka product (zarb) hai aur aage 2 bhi laga hua hai. Yeh bilkul product formula ka left side hai, is liye kaam aasaan hai.
Find kya karna hai? Isi expression ko do sines ke jama (sum) ki shakal mein likhna hai.
Plan: \(2\sin\alpha\cos\beta = \sin(\alpha + \beta) + \sin(\alpha - \beta)\) lagayenge, jahan \(\alpha = 3\theta\) aur \(\beta = \theta\).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(2\sin 3\theta \cos \theta\).
Humein find karna hai: isay sum ya difference ki shakal mein likhna.
Tareeqa: Product formula
\[2\sin\alpha\cos\beta\]
\[= \sin(\alpha + \beta) + \sin(\alpha - \beta)\]
Yeh formula is liye fit hai ke humare paas "2 sin cos" hai aur sine pehle aa raha hai. Pehchan yahi hai: pehle function aur doosre function ko dekh kar sahi formula chunein.

Angles ko match karein
\[\alpha = 3\theta, \quad \beta = \theta\]
\[\alpha + \beta = 4\theta\]
\[\alpha - \beta = 2\theta\]
Kyun: Formula mein \(\alpha\) sine ka angle hai aur \(\beta\) cosine ka. Is liye sine wala angle \(3\theta\) \(\alpha\) bana aur cosine wala \(\theta\) \(\beta\) bana. Phir sirf jama aur tafreeq (minus) karna hai.

Formula mein rakh dein
\[2\sin 3\theta\cos\theta\]
\[= \sin 4\theta + \sin 2\theta\]
Kyun: Formula kehta hai ke "2 sin cos" ka product = jama wale angle ka sine + farq wale angle ka sine. Product ab sum ban gaya, yahi sawal ka maqsad tha.

Tasdeeq: \(\theta = 30^{\circ}\) rakh kar dekhein
\[2\sin 90^{\circ}\cos 30^{\circ} = \sqrt{3}\]
\[\sin 120^{\circ} + \sin 60^{\circ}\]
\[= \tfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2} + \tfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2} = \sqrt{3} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Identity har angle ke liye sahi hoti hai, is liye ek aasaan angle rakh kar dono sides compare karna signs check karne ka tez tareeqa hai. Dono taraf \(\sqrt{3}\) aaya, matlab jawab sahi hai.

blocks.prompt: 1 (ii) Express the following products as sums or differences: \(2\cos 5\theta \sin 3\theta\)
blocks.explanation:
Yahan bhi 2 ke saath product hai, lekin is dafa cosine pehle hai aur sine baad mein. Yahi chhoti si baat formula badal deti hai.
Find kya karna hai? Isay do sines ke farq (difference) ki shakal mein likhna hai.
Plan: \(2\cos\alpha\sin\beta = \sin(\alpha + \beta) - \sin(\alpha - \beta)\), jahan \(\alpha = 5\theta\), \(\beta = 3\theta\).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(2\cos 5\theta\sin 3\theta\).
Humein find karna hai: sum ya difference.
Tareeqa: Product formula
\[2\cos\alpha\sin\beta\]
\[= \sin(\alpha + \beta) - \sin(\alpha - \beta)\]
Yeh is liye chuna ke order "cos phir sin" hai. Agar "sin cos" wala formula laga dete to doosre term ka sign ghalat ho jata.

Angles match karein
\[\alpha = 5\theta, \quad \beta = 3\theta\]
\[\alpha + \beta = 8\theta\]
\[\alpha - \beta = 2\theta\]
Kyun: \(\alpha\) cosine ka angle hai aur \(\beta\) sine ka. \(5\theta + 3\theta = 8\theta\) aur \(5\theta - 3\theta = 2\theta\).

Formula mein rakh dein
\[2\cos 5\theta\sin 3\theta\]
\[= \sin 8\theta - \sin 2\theta\]
Kyun: "cos sin" wale formula mein doosre term se pehle minus hota hai; "sin cos" se bas yahi farq hai.
Dhyan dein: Bohat se students yahan plus likh dete hain. Pehle dekhein cos pehle hai ya sin, phir sign likhein.

Tasdeeq: \(\theta = 10^{\circ}\) rakhein
\[2\cos 50^{\circ}\sin 30^{\circ} = \cos 50^{\circ}\]
\[\sin 80^{\circ} - \sin 20^{\circ}\]
\[= 2\cos 50^{\circ}\sin 30^{\circ} = \cos 50^{\circ} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Jawab ko ulta sum-to-product formula se wapas product banaya to wohi value mili, is liye sign sahi hai. Yeh dono formulas ek doosre ke ulat hain, is liye ek se doosre ko check kar sakte hain.

blocks.prompt: 1 (iii) Express the following products as sums or differences: \(\sin 5\theta \cos 2\theta\)
blocks.explanation:
Sine aur cosine ka product hai, lekin aage 2 nahi hai. Saare product formulas 2 se shuru hote hain, is liye pehle 2 banana parega.
Find kya karna hai? Isay sum ki shakal mein likhna hai.
Plan: 2 se multiply aur 2 se divide karein, phir "2 sin cos" wala formula lagayein.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\sin 5\theta\cos 2\theta\).
Humein find karna hai: sum ya difference.
Tareeqa: Isay \(\tfrac{1}{2}(2\sin 5\theta\cos 2\theta)\) likh kar
\[2\sin\alpha\cos\beta\]
\[= \sin(\alpha + \beta) + \sin(\alpha - \beta)\]
lagayenge.

2 ka factor banayein
\[\sin 5\theta\cos 2\theta\]
\[= \tfrac{1}{2}(2\sin 5\theta\cos 2\theta)\]
Kyun: 2 se multiply aur \(\tfrac{1}{2}\) se multiply dono ek saath karein to asal mein 1 se multiply hua, value nahi badli. Bas formula wali shakal ban gayi. Yeh trick is exercise mein baar baar aayegi.

Angles match kar ke formula lagayein
\[\alpha = 5\theta, \quad \beta = 2\theta\]
\[= \tfrac{1}{2}[\sin 7\theta + \sin 3\theta]\]
Kyun: \(5\theta + 2\theta = 7\theta\) aur \(5\theta - 2\theta = 3\theta\). Aage wala \(\tfrac{1}{2}\) wohi hai jo humne 2 banate waqt lagaya tha.
Dhyan dein: \(\tfrac{1}{2}\) likhna bhool jana sab se aam ghalti hai; us ke baghair jawab double ho jata hai.

Tasdeeq: \(\theta = 30^{\circ}\)
\[\sin 150^{\circ}\cos 60^{\circ} = \tfrac{1}{4}\]
\[\tfrac{1}{2}(\sin 210^{\circ} + \sin 90^{\circ})\]
\[= \tfrac{1}{2}(-\tfrac{1}{2} + 1) = \tfrac{1}{4} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(\sin 150^{\circ} = \tfrac{1}{2}\), \(\cos 60^{\circ} = \tfrac{1}{2}\), aur \(\sin 210^{\circ} = -\tfrac{1}{2}\) (third quadrant mein sine negative). Dono sides \(\tfrac{1}{4}\) hain.

blocks.prompt: 1 (iv) Express the following products as sums or differences: \(2\sin 7\theta \sin 2\theta\)
blocks.explanation:
Do sines ka product hai aur aage 2 hai. Do sines ka product hamesha cosines ka farq banta hai.
Find kya karna hai? Isay cosines ke difference ki shakal mein likhna hai.
Plan: \(2\sin\alpha\sin\beta = \cos(\alpha - \beta) - \cos(\alpha + \beta)\). Yeh kitab ka formula \(-2\sin\alpha\sin\beta = \cos(\alpha + \beta) - \cos(\alpha - \beta)\) hi hai, dono taraf \(-1\) se multiply kar ke.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(2\sin 7\theta\sin 2\theta\).
Humein find karna hai: sum ya difference.
Tareeqa: Kitab ke formula ko \(-1\) se multiply karne par
\[2\sin\alpha\sin\beta\]
\[= \cos(\alpha - \beta) - \cos(\alpha + \beta)\]
Is shakal mein left side par minus nahi rehta, is liye isay yaad rakhna aur lagana aasaan hai.

Angles match karein
\[\alpha = 7\theta, \quad \beta = 2\theta\]
\[\alpha - \beta = 5\theta\]
\[\alpha + \beta = 9\theta\]
Kyun: Is formula mein farq wala angle pehle aata hai aur jama wala baad mein. Bara angle \(\alpha\) lene se farq positive rehta hai.

Formula mein rakh dein
\[2\sin 7\theta\sin 2\theta\]
\[= \cos 5\theta - \cos 9\theta\]
Kyun: Yeh seedha formula hai humare angles ke saath.
Dhyan dein: \(\cos 9\theta - \cos 5\theta\) likhna ghalat hai, us mein sign ulta ho jata hai. Yaad rakhein: "sin sin" mein pehle difference, phir sum.

Tasdeeq: \(\theta = 10^{\circ}\)
\[2\sin 70^{\circ}\sin 20^{\circ} \approx 0.643\]
\[\cos 50^{\circ} - \cos 90^{\circ} \approx 0.643 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(\cos 90^{\circ} = 0\), is liye right side \(\cos 50^{\circ}\) hai aur calculator se left side bhi utna hi aata hai. Terms ka order sahi hai.

blocks.prompt: 1 (v) Express the following products as sums or differences: \(\cos(x + y)\sin(x - y)\)
blocks.explanation:
Cosine aur sine ka product hai, 2 nahi hai, aur angles khud jama aur farq ki shakal mein hain. Brackets ka khayal rakhna sab se zaroori hai.
Find kya karna hai? Sines ka difference.
Plan: 2 ka factor banayein, "cos sin" wala formula lagayein, aur angles ko brackets ke saath jama/minus karein.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\cos(x + y)\sin(x - y)\).
Humein find karna hai: sum ya difference.
Tareeqa: Isay \(\tfrac{1}{2}[2\cos(x + y)\sin(x - y)]\) likh kar
\[2\cos\alpha\sin\beta\]
\[= \sin(\alpha + \beta) - \sin(\alpha - \beta)\]
lagayenge, kyunke order "cos phir sin" hai.

Naye angles nikalein
\[\alpha = x + y, \quad \beta = x - y\]
\[\alpha + \beta = (x + y) + (x - y) = 2x\]
\[\alpha - \beta = (x + y) - (x - y) = 2y\]
Kyun: Jama mein \(y\) aur \(-y\) cancel ho gaye. Farq mein poora bracket \((x - y)\) minus hua, is liye \(-(-y) = +y\) bana aur \(x\) cancel ho gaya.
Dhyan dein: Bracket lagaye baghair \(x + y - x - y = 0\) likhna aam ghalti hai.

Formula mein rakh dein
\[\cos(x + y)\sin(x - y)\]
\[= \tfrac{1}{2}[\sin 2x - \sin 2y]\]
Kyun: \(\tfrac{1}{2}\) us 2 ko balance karta hai jo humne banaya tha, aur "cos sin" ki wajah se beech mein minus aaya.

Tasdeeq: \(x = 60^{\circ}\), \(y = 30^{\circ}\)
\[\cos 90^{\circ}\sin 30^{\circ} = 0\]
\[\tfrac{1}{2}(\sin 120^{\circ} - \sin 60^{\circ}) = 0 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(\cos 90^{\circ} = 0\) aur \(\sin 120^{\circ} = \sin 60^{\circ}\), is liye dono sides zero hain.

blocks.prompt: 1 (vi) Express the following products as sums or differences: \(\cos(2x + 30^{\circ})\cos(2x - 30^{\circ})\)
blocks.explanation:
Do cosines ka product hai, 2 nahi hai. Do cosines ka product cosines ka jama banta hai.
Find kya karna hai? Sum ki shakal.
Plan: 2 ka factor banayein, \(2\cos\alpha\cos\beta = \cos(\alpha + \beta) + \cos(\alpha - \beta)\) lagayein, aur aakhir mein \(\cos 60^{\circ} = \tfrac{1}{2}\) rakh dein.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\cos(2x + 30^{\circ})\cos(2x - 30^{\circ})\).
Humein find karna hai: sum ya difference.
Tareeqa: Product formula
\[2\cos\alpha\cos\beta\]
\[= \cos(\alpha + \beta) + \cos(\alpha - \beta)\]
Do cosines ke liye yahi formula hai; dono terms plus hain.

Naye angles nikalein
\[\alpha + \beta = 4x\]
\[\alpha - \beta = 60^{\circ}\]
Kyun: \((2x + 30^{\circ}) + (2x - 30^{\circ}) = 4x\), \(30^{\circ}\) cancel. Aur \((2x + 30^{\circ}) - (2x - 30^{\circ}) = 30^{\circ} + 30^{\circ} = 60^{\circ}\), yahan \(2x\) cancel aur minus-minus plus ban gaya.

Formula lagayein
\[\cos(2x + 30^{\circ})\cos(2x - 30^{\circ})\]
\[= \tfrac{1}{2}(\cos 4x + \cos 60^{\circ})\]
Kyun: Product ko "2 cos cos" ka aadha likha, is liye aage \(\tfrac{1}{2}\).

Mazeed simplify (agar chahein)
\[= \tfrac{1}{2}\cos 4x + \tfrac{1}{2}\cdot\tfrac{1}{2}\]
\[= \tfrac{1}{2}\cos 4x + \tfrac{1}{4}\]
Kyun: \(\cos 60^{\circ} = \tfrac{1}{2}\) yaad hai. Kitab ki answer key \(\tfrac{1}{2}(\cos 4x + \cos 60^{\circ})\) wali shakal deti hai; dono jawab sahi hain, exam mein dono qubool hain.

Tasdeeq: \(x = 15^{\circ}\)
\[\cos 60^{\circ}\cos 0^{\circ} = \tfrac{1}{2}\]
\[\tfrac{1}{2}\cos 60^{\circ} + \tfrac{1}{4} = \tfrac{1}{2} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(x = 15^{\circ}\) par \(2x + 30^{\circ} = 60^{\circ}\) aur \(2x - 30^{\circ} = 0^{\circ}\). Dono sides \(\tfrac{1}{2}\) aaye.

blocks.prompt: 1 (vii) Express the following products as sums or differences: \(\sin 12^{\circ} \sin 46^{\circ}\)
blocks.explanation:
Fixed angles ke do sines ka product hai, aage 2 nahi hai.
Find kya karna hai? Cosines ka difference.
Plan: 2 ka factor banayein, bara angle pehle rakhein, aur \(2\sin\alpha\sin\beta = \cos(\alpha - \beta) - \cos(\alpha + \beta)\) lagayein.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\sin 12^{\circ}\sin 46^{\circ}\).
Humein find karna hai: sum ya difference.
Tareeqa: Isay \(\tfrac{1}{2}(2\sin 46^{\circ}\sin 12^{\circ})\) likh kar
\[2\sin\alpha\sin\beta\]
\[= \cos(\alpha - \beta) - \cos(\alpha + \beta)\]
lagayenge.

Order badlein aur angles match karein
\[\alpha = 46^{\circ}, \quad \beta = 12^{\circ}\]
\[\alpha - \beta = 34^{\circ}\]
\[\alpha + \beta = 58^{\circ}\]
Kyun: Zarb kisi bhi order mein ho, jawab wohi rehta hai (\(3 \times 5 = 5 \times 3\)). Bara angle \(\alpha\) lene se farq \(34^{\circ}\) positive aata hai. Agar \(12^{\circ}\) pehle lete to \(\cos(-34^{\circ})\) aata, jo \(\cos 34^{\circ}\) hi hai, lekin ek qadam zyada.

Formula mein rakh dein
\[\sin 12^{\circ}\sin 46^{\circ}\]
\[= \tfrac{1}{2}(\cos 34^{\circ} - \cos 58^{\circ})\]
Kyun: \(\tfrac{1}{2}\) us 2 ko balance karta hai jo humne banaya. Jawab kitab ki answer key se milta hai.

Tasdeeq calculator se
\[\sin 12^{\circ}\sin 46^{\circ} \approx 0.1496\]
\[\tfrac{1}{2}(0.8290 - 0.5299) \approx 0.1496 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Dono taraf chaar decimal tak ek hi value aayi. Exam mein table ya calculator mana ho to yeh check sirf rough kaam mein karein.

blocks.prompt: 1 (viii) Express the following products as sums or differences: \(\sin(x + 45^{\circ})\sin(x - 45^{\circ})\)
blocks.explanation:
Do sines ka product, 2 nahi hai, aur angles mein \(x\) ke saath \(45^{\circ}\) jama aur minus hai.
Find kya karna hai? Cosines ka difference.
Plan: 2 ka factor banayein, "2 sin sin" wala formula lagayein, phir \(\cos 90^{\circ} = 0\) se simplify karein.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\sin(x + 45^{\circ})\sin(x - 45^{\circ})\).
Humein find karna hai: sum ya difference.
Tareeqa: Isay \(2\sin\alpha\sin\beta\) ka aadha likh kar
\[2\sin\alpha\sin\beta\]
\[= \cos(\alpha - \beta) - \cos(\alpha + \beta)\]
lagayenge.

Naye angles nikalein
\[\alpha = x + 45^{\circ}, \quad \beta = x - 45^{\circ}\]
\[\alpha - \beta = 90^{\circ}\]
\[\alpha + \beta = 2x\]
Kyun: Farq mein \(x\) cancel ho gaye aur \(45^{\circ} - (-45^{\circ}) = 90^{\circ}\) bana. Jama mein \(45^{\circ}\) cancel ho gaye aur \(2x\) bacha.

Formula mein rakh dein
\[\sin(x + 45^{\circ})\sin(x - 45^{\circ})\]
\[= \tfrac{1}{2}(\cos 90^{\circ} - \cos 2x)\]
Kyun: "sin sin" mein pehle farq wala angle, phir jama wala.

Mazeed simplify (agar chahein)
\[= \tfrac{1}{2}(0 - \cos 2x)\]
\[= -\tfrac{1}{2}\cos 2x\]
Kyun: \(\cos 90^{\circ} = 0\). Answer key \(\tfrac{1}{2}(\cos 90^{\circ} - \cos 2x)\) wali shakal deti hai; aakhri shakal zyada saaf hai aur dono sahi hain.

Tasdeeq: \(x = 45^{\circ}\)
\[\sin 90^{\circ}\sin 0^{\circ} = 0\]
\[-\tfrac{1}{2}\cos 90^{\circ} = 0 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(\sin 0^{\circ} = 0\), is liye left side zero; right side bhi zero. Jawab sahi hai.
